notes.text:
**Scope addition — the self-checkout case (2026-08-28).** A second place `PKG_ROOT` can sit inside the repo root: when the repo *is* hkb (this checkout, or any fork developing it). Today that case falls through to the old branches — no global `hkb` → an absolute machine path into `settings.local.json`, and `hookPlacement` keeps a bare `hkb hook …` in the tracked file because the bare form counts as portable. So hkb's own board keeps logging `hkb: not found` on every tool call after this card as first written.

Treat it as the same case with a different file: `PKG_ROOT === repo root` → `node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/hkb.js" hook <verb>`, same `[ -f … ] || exit 0` guard, same *portable* classification, tracked file by default. Detection is one comparison next to the `node_modules/` one: `PKG_ROOT` under the repo root at all → `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` + the relative remainder (`node_modules/hkb-cli` or nothing). One helper covers both.

This repo's `.claude/settings.json` already carries that form (edited by hand today, ahead of this card) — so `doctor`'s `checkHooks`/`hookCommandNeeds` must resolve `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` to the repo root when it checks the file exists, or `hkb doctor` here reports the file "not there", and `hkb init` here must recognise it as portable rather than move it to the local file. Add a test for both from this repo's own settings.

**Changes requested** (after attempt 1): Review of PR #147 — the devDependency shape is solid (673 tests, smoke proves the two-machine flow) and it correctly fixes doctor for the hand-written `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` form. Three things before it merges:

1. **The self-checkout case (this card's comment of 21:30, posted after your terminal verb) is not implemented.** `isLocalInstall` (src/model.js) requires `<root>/node_modules/`, and test/harness.test.js asserts `!isLocalInstall('/repo', '/repo')` — the opposite of the comment. On hkb's own checkout `hkbCommandForHook` still returns an absolute machine path and `hkb init` leaves the tracked bare `hkb hook …` alone, so doctor's fix (`hkb init`) is a no-op on the repo whose noise motivated the card. Make detection "PKG_ROOT is under root at all" and use the real POSIX `path.relative(root, PKG_ROOT)` remainder (empty for the checkout itself, `node_modules/hkb-cli` for the install) → `node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/<rel>/bin/hkb.js"` with the same guard, classified portable, tracked file. Flip that test, and add one that reads this repo's own .claude/settings.json (main now carries the `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/hkb.js` form) through hookCommandNeeds / isPortableHookCommand / hookPlacement / installClaudeHooks and expects it left byte-identical.

2. **`localInstallRel` fabricates `node_modules/hkb-cli/bin/hkb.js` instead of measuring it** (src/init.js ~213). A nested or pnpm-store PKG_ROOT is detected but the written path never exists, so the guard exits 0 forever and doctor says "npm install". Item 1's real-remainder helper removes this and the `packageInfo()` plumbing.

3. **`features/web-board.md` went stale** from this PR's src/board.js + src/init.js edits (baseline was 5 stale pages, not 6) — re-verify and re-stamp it; do not claim the stale set is unchanged.

Name as a filed follow-up, not in this PR: the stricter `hkbOnPath` now makes `installHarness` (templates/codex, templates/copilot `{{command}}`) and `mcpLaunch` (.mcp.json) write absolute machine paths into tracked files on a local-install repo — a cwd-relative `node node_modules/hkb-cli/bin/hkb.js` likely suffices there. results.summary: hkb init now supports `npm i -D hkb-cli`. It detects the shape by path (PKG_ROOT under <repo>/node_modules/, `isLocalInstall` in src/model.js — never PATH, because npx's node_modules/.bin makes PATH lie) and writes `f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/hkb-cli/bin/hkb.js"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec node "$f" hook <verb>` into the TRACKED .claude/settings.json with no --shared-hooks: the command is exact here and correct on every other machine at once, so a teammate's `git pull && npm install` is the whole setup. The path is built from package.json's name+bin (`packageInfo`), never a literal. The guard is for the worker worktree, which has no node_modules until `npm ci`; both hooks are inert without KB_TASK, so before the install it is a silent exit 0. Three supporting changes: `hkbOnPath` now strips node_modules/.bin from PATH before asking (`stripNodeModulesBin`); `hookCommandNeeds` was generalised, not special-cased — it records VAR= assignments, expands $VAR/${VAR}, finds `node` anywhere in the line, and returns a `guarded` flag (this changed its return shape, so its deepEqual assertions gained `guarded: false`); `isHkbHookCommand` accepts a `;` after the binary, since the new form names hkb.js inside an assignment. doctor resolves $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR against the repo before looking, prints the resolved file, warns (naming `npm install`) when a guarded file is missing, and fails a bare `hkb` on a local-install repo naming `hkb init`. The global install and --shared-hooks are unchanged: this is a third case. For #144, which branches from this merge: the seam to reuse is `hkbCommandForHook(verb, { root, localRel })` plus `checkHooks(ctx, sink, { localRel })` — both take the answer as an injectable option, which is also how the tests fake an install. `installClaudeHooks` returns `local: <rel|null>` so callers can say which shape they got.

results.summary:
Continued PR #147 for the three review items; merged origin/main twice (886eff8, then 2c62289 after #148 landed mid-attempt).

1. SELF-CHECKOUT CASE, IMPLEMENTED. Detection is now "is the running hkb under the repo root at all", not "under <root>/node_modules/". `isLocalInstall` is gone; `insideRepo(root, target)` (src/model.js) returns the real POSIX remainder — '' for hkb's own checkout, `node_modules/hkb-cli` for a devDependency, null for anything outside. `projectBinRel` (src/init.js, was `localInstallRel`) joins that remainder to `packageBinRel()`, the bin entry read from package.json, so the written path is MEASURED: a pnpm store (`node_modules/.pnpm/hkb-cli@x/node_modules/hkb-cli`) or a nested install is named as it actually is. That removes item 2's fabrication and the `packageInfo()` plumbing with it. Two paths under the root are refused rather than named: an npx cache anywhere, and `.claude/worktrees/<attempt>` (gitignored, gone with the attempt — a hazard the widened rule opened, so it is closed here with a test). On hkb's own checkout `hkb init` now writes `f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/hkb.js"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec node "$f" hook <verb>` into the tracked file, and `hkb doctor` on this repo now FAILS the bare `hkb` naming `hkb init` — doctor's fix is no longer a no-op on the repo whose noise filed the card. Naming followed: option/field `localRel` → `binRel` everywhere (init, doctor, the return of installClaudeHooks), which #144 should adopt.

2. THE BYTE-IDENTICAL TEST, WITH ONE DEVIATION YOU NEED TO KNOW. The review said main carries the `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/hkb.js` form in .claude/settings.json — it does not; main still has the bare `hkb hook stop`, and MY SESSION IS DENIED WRITES TO .claude/settings.json (the Write tool was refused under don't-ask mode; I did not route around it). So the test reads this repo's committed .claude/settings.json, copies it into a scratch repo, runs `installClaudeHooks(..., {binRel: BIN})` over the real content and asserts: it stays in the tracked file, every command comes out as `guardedHookCommand(BIN, verb)`, hookCommandNeeds/isPortableHookCommand/hookPlacement all agree, $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR resolves to a file that exists, and a second run is byte-identical. It exercises the same chain the review asked for, on real content, without depending on a file I cannot change. **The one thing left for you: run `hkb init` in the checkout (or apply the two-line change) to commit the portable form.** That is now a one-command fix, which is the point of the card.

3. WEB-BOARD RE-STAMPED, AND THE STALE SET IS NOT WHAT THE REVIEW SAID. Measured against the current origin/main: 7 of 8 pages were ALREADY stale there, features/web-board among them — #148's re-stamp of it never landed, so its serve.js/board.js/init.js shas still pointed at cb9e43d. I re-read all sixteen of its line anchors and corrected thirteen (most drifted from #143/#148, not from this branch); it is fresh again. features/up-and-down went stale from this branch and got a true no-op re-stamp: my model.js change is one 39-line insertion above everything it cites, so every citation below shifted by exactly 39 and was corrected. Net: the wiki is at 6 stale, one FEWER than origin/main, and both pages this branch touched are fresh. The other 6 were stale before this branch and none of their claims are about hook commands.

Also: docs/harnesses.md's table is now four rows keyed on where the running hkb lives (two of them tracked-file rows) plus the measured-path and refused-path paragraphs and doctor's third verdict; the wiki page was rewritten for the same; smoke-pack's local-install check became `checkInitInsideRepo` called twice — as a devDependency and as a checkout of hkb itself — and both prove the tracked file names the measured path and never the temp dir.

NOT DONE, deliberately: the review's last line asked me to name a follow-up about "the stricter `hkbOnPath` n…" — it reached me truncated, so I did not file a card from half a sentence. The concrete risk I can see in the code, for whoever writes it: stripping every `node_modules/.bin` entry hides a genuinely global hkb whose bin directory happens to end in `node_modules/.bin` (some npm-prefix layouts), and init then writes an absolute path instead of the bare `hkb` — wrong-looking, not broken, since that path is durable.
